feature.summary: A run can pause on several tool calls at once. The server only resumes when it gets one decision for every pending call, then resumes once. Tasks screens apply one Approve or Deny to all calls. The CLI has Allow All and Deny All for the rest of a turn.

purpose.what_it_does: Lets the person answer all pending calls of one run together so the run resumes a single time (apps/web/lib/services/cloud-agent-run-service.ts:1964-1972).
purpose.why_it_exists: A model can ask for several tools in one step; asking one by one would need many resumes, and the server refuses a partial answer.
purpose.who_uses_it: People managing background work on Web, Desktop, Mobile, VS Code and the CLI.
problems_solved: No half-answered step: the server rejects a decision set that does not match the pending set (cloud-agent-run-service.ts:1964).
No repeated prompts for the rest of a CLI turn (apps/cli/src/tui/approval_broker.rs:325-326).
use_cases: Tasks page: a run waits on three calls; the person presses Approve once.
Mobile run detail: Reject all pending calls.
CLI: press t (Allow All) to allow the rest of the turn except high-risk calls.
VS Code: command 'Approve and continue' on a cloud task.

where_to_find_it: Web, Desktop (hosted web app) and shared Tasks page: 'Waiting for your approval' card, buttons 'Approve' and 'Deny' (TasksPage.tsx:891-900).
Mobile: Tasks screen run detail sheet with approve and reject, store action resolveApproval (apps/mobile/src/features/tasks/store.ts:311, apps/mobile/src/features/tasks/CloudTasksScreen.tsx:840).
CLI: 'd Deny All' and 't Allow All' buttons (approval_overlay.rs:5-21, :95-118).
VS Code: commands agi-workforce.approveCloudTask and agi-workforce.rejectCloudTask, confirmation 'Approve and continue' (apps/extension-vscode/src/features/cloud-tasks/cloudRunApproval.ts:38-41).
Web chat card: calls of one step are answered one by one on their cards; the request is sent when the last one is decided (useChatStream.ts:5494).
prerequisites: A signed-in account with a paused cloud run.
screens_and_controls: The list of calls with a short preview of each (argsPreview) (TasksPage.tsx:892-896).
Optional guidance box 'Add guidance to steer this run (optional)' (TasksPage.tsx, after line 891).
journey: 1. Open Tasks and filter to runs that need you.
2. Read the list of pending calls.
3. Press Approve or Deny; one decision is applied to every call (TasksPage.tsx:471-480).
4. The list reloads; the run shows running or done.
feedback_and_outputs: The Approve button shows pending while sending (TasksPage.tsx:901).
On a race: 'Another device already answered this approval.' (TasksPage.tsx:178).
VS Code: 'your decision could not be sent, another device already answered this one' (cloudRunApproval.ts:30-32, :157).
settings: none specific; CLI Allow All respects the high-risk exception in code (approval_broker.rs:196).

working: Server accepts 1 to 32 decisions and demands the exact pending set (cloud-agent-run-service.ts:1920-1972; packages/contracts/cloud-contracts/src/tool-approval-resume.ts:34).

The Tasks page sends the same decision for every call in the run (TasksPage.tsx:476-480); Mobile does the same (apps/mobile/src/features/tasks/store.ts:326-332); VS Code does the same (cloudRunApproval.ts:22-26).
Web and Mobile chat gather per-call decisions and send once when all are decided (useChatStream.ts:5494; chatExecutionStore.ts:4358).
A saved Deny in the permission store overrides an approval in the batch (approve/route.ts:516-523).
A tool no longer available gets a 'not available and was not executed' result instead of failing the batch (tool-loop.ts:6580-6600).
CLI broker supports deny_all and allow_all for a turn (approval_broker.rs:325-326, :401, :437); Allow All excludes high-risk and some kinds (approval_broker.rs:196-215).
incomplete: Tasks, Mobile and VS Code cannot mix decisions in one answer (all approve or all reject); mixed decisions are possible only on chat cards (TasksPage.tsx:476, useChatStream.ts:5494).
Chrome: brief says unverified; per-call buttons exist (bubbles.ts:1004) but no batch control was found.
not_available: Batch control in the Chrome side panel was not found.

established.statement: The user can approve or deny several pending tool calls of a run in one action.
All pending calls of one run are decided together and the run resumes once.
The brief does not say what happens when one call in the batch fails; not verified.

acceptance_criteria: One Approve on Tasks resumes the run once with all calls approved.
One Deny marks every call rejected and the model gets the denied result for each.
A decision set missing a pending call is refused with 400.
CLI Allow All does not auto-allow a high-risk call.
inferred: A mixed answer (allow some, deny others) should be possible on Tasks screens; the server allows it [inferred from schema in tool-approval-resume.ts:34].
proposed: [proposed] Per-call checkboxes on the Tasks card.
[proposed] Define and show what happens when an approved call fails.

steps.what_happens: Run pauses with several pending calls saved in one checkpoint.
Client builds the decision list for all pending calls and posts it detached.
Server claims the checkpoint only if the ids match exactly, then resumes once.
CLI turn grant resolves the pending and future requests of that turn on the device.

corrections.claim: Web and Mobile chat gather per-call decisions and send once when all are decided (useChatStream.ts:5494; chatExecutionStore.ts:4358)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The logic exists, but the cited lines are only the hook declaration (useChatStream.ts:5494) and the function header (apps/mobile/stores/chat/chatExecutionStore.ts:4358). The gather is at useChatStream.ts:~5565-5590 (return while decisions.size < calls.length, otherwise send) and mobile chatExecutionStore.ts:4420. A desktop copy of the store also exists.
corrections.correction: Web and Mobile chat cards collect one decision per call and send the request once decisions.size equals calls.length (useChatStream.ts:~5565-5585; chatExecutionStore.ts:4420). The send loop treats any undecided call as 'rejected' (useChatStream.ts:~5592).

corrections.claim: A tool no longer available gets a 'not available and was not executed' result (tool-loop.ts:6580-6600)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The file is apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/tool-loop.ts, not a bare tool-loop.ts. The message applies only to an approved call whose tool is not offered (:6576-6588). Rejected calls get the denied message.
corrections.correction: An approved call whose tool is no longer offered gets 'Tool X is not available and was not executed.' and the batch continues.

missing_facts: Chat cards treat any call left undecided as 'rejected' when the request is finally sent (apps/web/lib/hooks/useChatStream.ts:~5592, turn.decisions.get(...) ?? 'rejected'). The page does not say this.

Approvals expire: the pending checkpoint is only claimable within APPROVAL_CHECKPOINT_TTL_HOURS, and a later attempt returns 410 (cloud-agent-run-service.ts:1930-1945; approve/route.ts:142-144). Section 6 lists retention as unknown.

CLI Deny All resolves requests as Cancel, not as a per-call denial. It also latches for the rest of the turn, because the broker is per-turn and discarded at turn end (approval_broker.rs:429-445, 325).
